{"question":{"id":"q16","question":"黑狼怪人倒下后为何又能暴起？它对风信子做了什么？","readAt":{"chapter":4,"paragraph":101},"group":"ordinary","category":"event","expected":"这是强化药A赋予黑狼怪人的倒下后发动的终极能力；黑狼怪人复活后从口中喷出无数黑影，打飞风信子的大剑，并一把抓住她。","certainty":"supported","evidence":[{"chapter":4,"paragraph":96,"quote":"——无数黑影从它口中喷吐而出！"},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":97,"quote":"少女只来得及惊叫一声，那由魔杖化成的大剑便在暗影冲击中脱手而出，南小风整个人都被砸得倒飞而出！"},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":100,"quote":"借着月光认真观赏起魔法少女风信子被复活的黑狼怪人一把抓住的狼狈模样。"},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":101,"quote":"没错，这是那瓶强化药A赋予黑狼怪人的终极能力，能在倒下后发动的力量！"}]},"answer":{"queries":3,"sourceQueries":0,"exhausted":false,"answer":{"text":"黑狼怪人并非真正被解决：它脑袋吃下风信子大剑后倒伏、哀嚎几声没了动静，但随后苏天晴在脸侧轻轻拍掌，原本倒伏在地的黑狼便骤然暴起，从口中喷吐出的不是魔力光束，而是无数黑影，将风信子由魔杖化成的大剑冲击脱手，并把南小风整个人砸得倒飞出去，南小风惊叫“好恶心”。就现有记录看，暴起的直接触发点是苏天晴的拍掌；黑狼对风信子（南小风）做的是用口中的无数黑影发动暗影冲击，击飞其武器和本人，尚未见其他明确行为。","status":"answered","recordIds":["c04:B16","c04:B24"],"sources":[{"chapter":4,"paragraph":57},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":58},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":59},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":60},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":91},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":92},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":93},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":94},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":95},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":96},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":97},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":98}]},"history":[{"requests":[{"command":"search","query":"黑狼","kind":"beat","limit":10,"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},{"command":"search","query":"暴起","kind":"beat","limit":10,"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},{"command":"search","query":"风信子","kind":"episode","limit":10,"perspective":"reader","world":"original"}],"results":[{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"search","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-4","sourceManifest":"manifest:ab921696d519ac1a","knowledgeRevision":4,"readAt":{"chapter":4,"paragraph":129},"contentHash":"2123d98d1e4add30fc01cf4b64041aa9bb8c95ccce05a21d9e21e7aa2b744de8"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":4,"paragraph":101},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"record","record":{"id":"c04:
